mapper.select: select count(1) from ods_event_report er INNER JOIN ods_user u on (er.user_id = u.id and u.pkg = er.pkg) where er.dates = #{dates} and er.event_msg is not null and JSON_VALID(er.event_msg) and JSON_LENGTH(er.event_msg) > 0

select 'ods_event_report' source, er.id source_id, er.dates, IFNULL(u.id, er.user_id) user_id, er.event_id, er.event_msg, IFNULL(er.event_msg ->> '$.pvn', 'unknown') version, u.dates register_dates, u.create_time register_date, u.pkg, uvq.pvn register_version, IFNULL(uh.address, 'IN') country, TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, u.create_time, er.create_time) register_cohort_day, TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, u.dates, er.dates) register_day, er.create_time from ods_event_report er INNER JOIN ods_user u on (er.user_id = u.id and u.pkg = er.pkg) LEFT JOIN (SELECT uv.user_id, MIN(uv.pvn) pvn FROM ods_user_version uv where uv.dates <= #{dates} GROUP BY user_id) uvq on (uvq.user_id = u.id) LEFT JOIN ods_user_hema uh on (u.aid = uh.aid and uh.pkg = u.pkg) where er.dates = #{dates} and er.event_msg is not null and JSON_VALID(er.event_msg) and JSON_LENGTH(er.event_msg) > 0 limit #{rows} OFFSET #{startRows}

select dued.id, #{source} source, er.id source_id, er.dates, IFNULL(u.id, er.user_id) user_id, er.event_id, er.event_msg, IFNULL(er.event_msg ->> '$.pvn', 'unknown') version, u.dates register_dates, u.create_time register_date, u.pkg, dui.version register_version, IFNULL(uh.address, 'IN') country, TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, u.create_time, er.create_time) register_cohort_day, TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, u.dates, er.dates) register_day, er.create_time from ods_event_report er INNER JOIN ods_user u on (er.user_id = u.id and u.pkg = er.pkg) LEFT JOIN dim_user_info dui on (dui.user_id = u.id) LEFT JOIN ods_user_hema uh on (u.aid = uh.aid and uh.pkg = u.pkg) LEFT JOIN dwd_user_event_detail dued on (dued.source_id = er.id and dued.source = #{source}) where er.id = #{sourceId} and er.event_msg is not null and JSON_VALID(er.event_msg) and JSON_LENGTH(er.event_msg) > 0
select count(1) from ods_report_event re where re.dates = #{dates} and re.user_id is not null and re.event_msg is not null and JSON_VALID(re.event_msg)

select 'ods_report_event' source, re.id source_id, re.dates, re.user_id, re.event_id, re.event_msg, IFNULL(re.event_msg ->> '$.pvn', 'unknown') version, u.dates register_dates, u.create_time register_date, u.pkg, uv.pvn register_version, IFNULL(uh.address, 'IN') country, TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, u.create_time, re.create_time) register_cohort_day, TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, u.dates, re.dates) register_day, re.create_time from ods_report_event re INNER JOIN ods_user u on (re.user_id = u.id) LEFT JOIN (SELECT uv.user_id, MIN(uv.pvn) pvn FROM ods_user_version uv where uv.dates <= #{dates} GROUP BY user_id) uv on (uv.user_id = u.id) LEFT JOIN ods_user_hema uh on (u.aid = uh.aid and uh.pkg = u.pkg) where re.dates = #{dates} and re.event_msg is not null and JSON_VALID(re.event_msg) and JSON_LENGTH(re.event_msg) > 0 limit #{rows} OFFSET #{startRows}
